title: If You Don't Understand Leadership, You'll Never Win
promo_conflict: The host describes her own company and a downloadable hiring matrix. Member outcomes and internal practices are self-reported; no price or revenue results are given.

idea.name: Downloadable hiring matrix
idea.one_liner: A downloadable candidate-scoring matrix for employers, using five categories and a 25-point score; payment or monetisation is not stated.
idea.offer: A downloadable matrix for assessing candidates.

key_quotes.quote: I've realized you don't actually have a hiring problem, you have a filtering problem.
So in the hiring matrix, which you can download every single candidate is going to get this score.

claims.claim: The matrix evaluates candidates across five categories.
claims.quote: But the most important thing is an actual matrix that takes you through five categories.

claims.claim: A top score is five out of five and totals 25 points.
claims.quote: Five out of five for all of them. That's a 25.

claims.claim: A score of 25 is described as 100%.
claims.quote: Great. We're hiring that bad boy. That's a hundred percent.

claims.claim: Sanchez says she probably would not hire a candidate scoring below 18 out of 25.
claims.quote: Anybody below 18 out of 25, I'm probably not going to hire.

acquisition_channels.details: The video presents the matrix and says it can be downloaded.

ideas.delivery: A self-service digital download; the file format and download process are not stated.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies if the product collects or processes candidate data. Employment Agencies Regs 2003 would be relevant if the offer expanded into placing candidates.
